paite: Ka tapa, ka thute kem in, na kiang ah ka thupiakte kholkhawm in.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

paite: Ka thupiakte kem inla hing in; huan ka dan na mittang bang in,
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

paite: na khutzungte tung ah vial inla; na lungtang suangpek tung ah gelh in.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

paite: Pilna kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu na hi," chi inla, theihsiamna na tanaunu chi in.
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

paite: Numei lamdang a kipan nang ahon keptheihna ding un, athute a maitangphatnu mikhual a kipan.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

paite: Ka inn tohlet a pan ka dakkhia a, tohlet vang kal ah ka en paisuak a;
heading: Numei Thangtat
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

paite: huan mimawlte lak ah ka en a, tuailaite lak ah ka theikak a, tangval theihsiamna beipa,
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

paite: a-omna ningchin a kongzing a paisuak a, a-inn lam zuan a pai zelpa;
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

paite: khomui in, nitaklam in, zan mial bikbek leh khomial ah.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

paite: Ngai in, numei khat, kizuak puansilh silh, lungtang kiva in akituahpih a.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

paite: Amah ahi lawlaw a, atum tuntun a; akhe a-inn ah a-om ngei kei.
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

paite: Kongzing a om ton a-om a, mun liante a a-om ton a-om a, ning chiteng abuk zel hi.
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

paite: Huchi in amah amanta a, amah atawpta a, zummoh maitang toh in akiang ah.
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

paite: Lemna kithoihnate ka kiang ah a-om; tuni in ka thuchiamte ka peta hi.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

paite: Huaiziak in nang tuak ding in ka hong paikhia a, na mel thanuamtak a zong ding in, ka hon muta hi.
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

paite: Ka tutna nuam pialkhang phah zehoihte a zep, ka phah khinta, Aigupta khau puan gialte toh.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

paite: Ka lupna murrah, aloe leh sinamon in ka namtuisakta hi.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

paite: Hong pai in, zingsang matan i itna dimtek i la ding; itna in i kilungmuantuah ding.
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

paite: Ka pasal lah inn ah a-om ngal kei a, khual gamla ah azin hi.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

paite: Sum ip akitawi a; kha alik chiang in inn ah ahong pai ding, achi hi.
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

paite: Athugen siamna in amah akipesakta a, amuk a maitang phatnate in amah asawlmangta hi.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

paite: Amah azui pah a, goh ding a bawngtal apai bang in leh mihai bawlhoihna dia sikkhau khihmi bang in;
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

paite: thal in asin akap pailet tan; thang lam a vasa akintat bang in, huai tuh ahinna gun a hih athei kei hi.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

paite: Tu in, ka tapate, huaiziak in hon ngaikhia un, ka kam a thute limsak un.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

paite: Na lungtang amah lampi lam ah awn kei henla, lampite lam ah paimang kei hen.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

paite: Amah lah tampi liamsa in apai lumletta a; ahi, athahsate mihat tampi ahi uh.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

paite: A-inn Sheol zotna lampi ahi, sihna dantante zuan a sukpai.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.
